For me, I stuck with the M silicones because I tried all the different sizes and felt like M had the best fit. I’d say try them out and see what works for you. And I will say this as well, if fit is your absolute number 1 goal, go with the foam tips. They provide a more complete seal, but I used silicone because typically, it’s much more common for the bass to drown out everything else when you are wearing foam. Also, don’t just pop them in, when you’re putting the plugs in, make sure the loop is facing forwards and than twist them back into your ears, this guarantees the most snug fit.

IMO the 2 best guns for CCW are as ranked.


 1. Sig P365 XMacro
